task_objective: Remediate findings from a full project review: fix a critical timeout bug and several functional, typing, packaging, test-coverage, CI, and documentation issues (plan project_review_2026_06_12).
tests_added: tests/test_alias.py: test_add_game_alias_idempotent_when_unchanged, test_add_game_alias_updates_conflicting_alias (and rewrote test_add_game_alias for atomic write)

tests/test_ludusavi_metadata.py: test_manifest_update, test_manifest_update_force_and_timeout, test_schema_yaml_uses_text_mode, test_init_accepts_path_for_explicit_path, test_init_accepts_path_for_config_dir
tests/test_ludusavi_integration.py: test_cloud_set, test_complete, test_open_gui (and added timeout=None assertions to bulk_api/cloud/wrap tests)
design_decisions: Added LudusaviTimeoutError as a subclass of LudusaviError so existing `except LudusaviError` handlers keep working while callers can distinguish timeouts.

Long-running operations (wrap, cloud_upload, cloud_download, manifest_update, bulk_api) now default to timeout=None, matching the pre-existing backup/restore behavior; wrap() was the critical fix because the 30s executor default was killing any game session longer than 30 seconds.
Dropped the originally planned Task 3 (--gui flag on backup/restore) per user decision not to expose it.

Hardened add_game_alias to be idempotent (no write when unchanged), to update a conflicting alias in place, and to write atomically via a sibling .tmp file plus Path.replace so an interrupted write cannot corrupt config.yaml.
Changed backups_edit comment guard from `if comment:` to `if comment is not None:` so an intentional empty comment is sent.
Marked LudusaviApiOutput.errors/overall/cloud as NotRequired since the real CLI omits absent top-level fields; verified via __required_keys__/__optional_keys__ and ty.

Overloaded LudusaviExecutor.execute() by mode (non-SPAWN -> LudusaviResponse, SPAWN -> None) and removed 17 `assert response is not None` lines in main.py; ty passed cleanly so the documented revert fallback was not needed.
Widened Ludusavi.__init__ explicit_path/config_dir to Union[str, Path] and str()-coerced config_dir before extending command_prefix so subprocess receives string args.
Broadened discovery._verify to `except OSError` so NotADirectoryError and similar errors are treated as 'not found' instead of propagating.
Added a py.typed marker plus the Typing :: Typed classifier so consumers' type checkers honor the annotations; verified the wheel includes pyludusavi/py.typed.
Made regression fixture loading CWD-independent by resolving paths relative to __file__.
Added dev to the CI push/pull_request branch filters so the integration branch is tested.
results: Each change followed red-green TDD via ./run.sh uv run pytest. Full suite grew from 69 to 91 passing tests; ruff check, ruff format, and ty check src/ all pass. Work done on branch fix/project-review-2026-06-12 with atomic Conventional Commits, slated to merge to dev and release as v0.2.5.
